item.title: n2-001 - A private conversation
item.description: 要求 内化单词 + 语法 + 习惯用法。 听力 + 口语 + 写作练习 课前问题 [[how-to-create-a-sentence|如何根据格式造句]] 1. 课文 Last week, I went to the theater. I had a very good seat. The play was interesting. But I did not enjoy it. A young man and a young woman were sitting behind me. They were talking loudly. I got very angry.

item.title: n2-002 - Breakfast or lunch
item.description: 课前问题 be+doing vs do/does 感叹句？ 如何确定频率副词 adv. 的位置？ Always (100%) → Usually → Often/Frequently → Sometimes → Occasionally → Rarely/Seldom → Hardly ever → Never (0%) 课文 It was Sunday. I never get up early on Sundays. I sometimes stay in bed until lunch time. Last Sunday, I got up very late. I looked out of the window. It’s dark outside.

item.title: n2-012 - Goodbye and good luck
item.description: 课前问题 课文 Our neighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow. We’ll meet him at the harbour early in the morning. He will be in his small boat, Topsail. Topsail is a famous boat. It has sailed across the Atlantic many times. Capiton Alison will set out at eight o’clock, so we have plenty of time. We’ll see his boat and then say goodbye to him.

item.title: The Greenwood Boys
item.description: 课文 pop singers - all parts of the country. will be arriving, tomorrow - coming by train, young people, meeting singing at … - staying for 5 days during - give 5 performances. as usual, police, keep order - on these occasions Grammar [[will-be-doing|将来进行时]] : will be doing. 表示将来正在做。 表示已经安排好的事情。 (预料之中， 按计划会发生) 进行时态 (be + V-ing) 的核心是描述动态的、持续的动作。
